author: Codex
authorization_literal: Dale, revisa capital, clima y credibilidad antes de integrarlos. Prueba los cambios solo en 2023 con modelos estándar, conserva B00, deja las decisiones y resultados en el foro y mantén 2024 cerrado.

objective.calibration: No new calibration beyond B14 standard GLM; B15 conditional fold credibility c only on new business, without A/E correction.
objective.primary_development_metric: Pooled unweighted total-unit D2 Tweedie 1.5 on all 50094 OOF rows of 2023; global null is arithmetic mean of observed T0; do not average line D2 scores
objective.positivity: Fail on nonfinite or nonpositive rate/prediction; no silent clipping or removal

observation_link: Each development fold k uses frozen exclude_foldk/e_cost_mix_1.0, fitted only on other 2023 groups; all three model families use exactly the same link and T0 response.
features: B14 same exact six-feature core as B13; only x_log_sum_insured quality value changes. B15 no added feature. No climate, premium, raw IDs or audit flags as price predictors.

models.change: Fold-trained capital quality rule only; same six-feature GLM and parameters. Motor exact reuse.
Multiply new-business annual rate by c from own outer-training emerging coefficients and frozen developed prior. Renewal unchanged; no extra A/E balancing.

development_uncertainty.interval: 95% percentile, conditional exploratory diagnostic; NOT the 2024 Bonferroni confirmation interval
development_uncertainty.pairs: All120 pairs of16 recipes, shared2000 exploratory draws; independent numerical replay of29 new pairs only, prior OOF exact.

diagnostics.observation_sensitivity: At fixed fitted OOF rates, recompute predictions and response for reserve075, reserve125, late_cost05, late_cost10 using saved scoped links. This is an observation-only diagnostic, not a refit or the complete confirmation safeguards.
diagnostics.no_selection: Keep B00 and every alternative; no promotion, retirement, equivalence or final confirmation roster here.

readout_before_testing.capital: Compare B14 vsB13 on same target/link/rows; report number of restored cells per fold and effect in changed cells separately from other rows. All56 suspicious2023 rows have T0=0; metric cannot economically confirm their scale.
readout_before_testing.credibility: Compare B15 vsB14 and B00, c/Z/tau/fold dispersion and new-business line cells, plus aggregate level and own top31 influence. Never substitute a good A/E for deviance.
readout_before_testing.climate: Report rejected variants with reason and next admissible source needed; no score with inadmissible weather.
readout_before_testing.decision: Keep B00 and all alternatives regardless of point; no promotion, retirement or final roster.

technical_acceptance: Only2023 emerging materialized for fit/predict/score; no2024/test prices or ledger
Capital bounds learned in outer training, own-row formula and unchanged non-capital predictors
Exact B13 core/parameters and motor reuse
30 auxiliary training-only GLMs, cluster robust SE and score checks; frozen prior identified separately
No held-out targets in c/tau/calibration and no full2023 c reused
Blocked-fit replay, independent formulas, influence/new-pair bootstrap and temporal guards
All14 previous OOF exact and B00 retained
scope: Only emerging2023 price experiments with frozen developed prior artifact. No newly fitted or scored other year, no global F0 rewrite.
resources: Local CPU two threads; ten price GLM fits plus five exact motor reuses, thirty auxiliary Poisson/Gamma GLMs, fifteen c factors/adapters. No grid, remote or reseed.
search_disclosure: Sixth adaptive2023 trial,16 recipes after this wave. Two changes isolated as B14/B13 capital and B15/B14 credibility. No multiple-tuning or confirmation claim.
hypothesis: A business-segment constant and a small unpenalized main-effect GLM can clarify whether business level requires elaborate correction. Six prespecified technical features per line; no variable selection based on new scores.

core_recipe.categorical: OneHotEncoder drop=first, min_frequency=50, max_categories=40, handle_unknown=ignore, fit-only

capital_rule.fit_bounds: For each line/fold, normal rows are outer-training2023 capital>0 and <=threshold; learn minimum/maximum of 1000*written_premium/capital there only.
capital_rule.row_test: For own suspicious row capital>threshold, divide by1000 iff raw ppm<fit minimum and divided ppm lies within fit min/max. Failure remains NaN. Ordinary rows keep previous F0 value.
capital_rule.information: Own quoted written premium used solely as a scale audit, never a model predictor; no validation distribution, 2024 or test thresholds. It is a tariff-based scale assumption, not economic confirmation.
capital_rule.scope: 2023 only; private CLA table audited arithmetically, not blindly copied for future rows. No original/global F0 edit.

credibility_rule.reference: NB-CRED-01 proposed by Claude, adapted to audited training scope; conditional prototype, not a production decision.
credibility_rule.developed_prior: Frozen beta_dev/se_dev from coeficientes_glm_nb.csv and developed seasonal/reference categories from evidencia_decisiones.json (original developed2021-2023 fits). No developed refit or other-year pricing fit in this trial; prior raw fit not independently reproduced here.
credibility_rule.emerging_fit: Recompute Poisson frequency and Gamma positive severity GLMs for each line/outer fold with canonical2023 assigned claims only and original fixed COVS. Capital from this trial, fit-only logcapital median/center and region reference. Fixed developed seasonality. Cluster SE by saved customer-address component.
credibility_rule.tau: As original rule: max(0,mean((betaE-betaD)^2-SE_E^2-SE_D^2)) across matched non-region categorical coefficients with >=100 positive training claims; computed separately frequency/severity, across three training lines only.
credibility_rule.price_application: B15=B14*c for new business, B15=B14 for renewal, each line/fold. No ordinary OOF A/E balancing and no full2023 c. B14 unpenalized GLM already has business main effect; c shifts its training-relative level.
credibility_rule.technical: 30 auxiliary fits, numerical ridge1e-8, original IRLS max100/tol1e-10, finite positive mean, converged flag and independent mean score <=1e-4. Store coefficients/SE/training data; no silent clipping in pricing.
limits: Prior coefficient/seasonality uncertainty conditioned on frozen source; Z does not include estimated-prior uncertainty.
Tau uses correlated coefficients and few positives; no calibrated credibility interval or ultimate truth.
Frequency/severity auxiliary objective and cost-mark reporting differ from final Tweedie price objective; common pricing C0 stays fixed.
Ordinary OOF rows from other folds depend on the retained fold, so they are not nested calibration inputs.

climate_rule.decision: No prospective price candidate for CLIMA-S2-01: it uses2024 values for2023 and2025 in variable selection.
climate_rule.tests: Own temporal-availability guards reject source>=quote year, future-dependent selectors and no-history rows. Verify received adversarial evidence hash; do not repeat its permutation over unchanged source.
climate_rule.no_fake_model: Keep no-climate B00/B13/B14 as references; no identical missing-weather model or leaked-score comparator.
